post.caption: Cartier built a gold Moon lander. In 1969, Cartier made an exact gold copy of Apollo 11's lander. The French newspaper Le Figaro asked its readers to chip in, and three models were made, one for each astronaut. The astronauts received them on a visit to Paris in October 1969. Hidden inside each model is a roll of microfilm listing the names of the readers who donated. Cartier keeps Michael Collins's model in its own collection.
